WITH agg AS (
  SELECT
       COUNT(*) AS n,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "DAY_ID" IS NULL) AS null_0,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "MONTH_ID" IS NULL) AS null_1,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "QUARTER_ID" IS NULL) AS null_2,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "YEAR_ID" IS NULL) AS null_3,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "MONTH_NAME" IS NULL) AS null_4,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "MONTH_START_DATE" IS NULL) AS null_5,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "WEEKDAY_NAME" IS NULL) AS null_6,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE "YEAR_LABEL" IS NULL) AS null_7
  FROM "staging"."DIM_DATE"
)
SELECT 'row_count' AS check_name,
       CASE WHEN n > 0 THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END AS result,
       n AS count
FROM agg
UNION ALL
SELECT 'not_null:DAY_ID' AS check_name,
       CASE WHEN null_0 = 0 THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END AS result,
       null_0 AS count
FROM agg
UNION ALL
SELECT 'not_null:MONTH_ID' AS check_name,
       CASE WHEN null_1 = 0 THEN 'pass' ELSE 'fail' END AS result,
       null_1 AS count
FROM agg
